newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Cos EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Wednesday it raised its 1996 earnings estimate for St. Paul Cos Inc to $4.60 a share from $4.46, but retains its $5.50 a share 1997 estimate.
-- St. Paul this week reported third quarter earnings of $1.15 a share, down from $1.35 earned a year ago, but above EVEREN's estimate of $1.00 a share.
-- EVEREN said its price targets remain $61 a share for six months and $66 for 18-months. St. Paul shares Wednesday afternoon were down 3/4 at 54.
-- The rating remains market perform in the near-term and outperform for the long-term.
